posts.text: Can’t wait for the “historically accurate” depiction of a … poem brimming with magic, mythical monsters and pagan gods. Scylla will be a legit realistic six headed dragon. No woke casting of Athena, either. All historians know she was a white blonde deity. Totes real, too.
